However, the specification says "for each activity, provide a single most likely effort estimate." So we need to list activities. We can use story IDs as activity IDs.

technical_and_design_decisions: Use existing Spring Shell framework to implement tab completion (U6).
For aggregated progress bar (U1), implement a REST API aggregating sub-job progress and a frontend component using an existing UI framework (e.g., Angular or React).
For restart of composed jobs (U2), reuse existing job execution lifecycle APIs and add restart endpoint with state handling.
For Kafka integration investigation (U3), produce a design document and a proof-of-concept branch; no production code will be merged.
For Lattice infrastructure (U4), evaluate and document bootstrap scripts using Cloud Foundry Lattice or similar container orchestration.
For dot-delimited property resolution (U5), extend Spring Cloud Stream's property binding to parse dot notation for Tuple and JSON.
For Mesos deployment (U7), create Marathon application definitions and Docker images for Spring Cloud Data Flow.
For moving Redis @Rule (U8), extract the test utility into a separate Maven module and publish as a standalone artifact.
assumptions: All user stories are independent and can be implemented in any order; no dependencies between stories except where noted.
The developer is familiar with the existing Spring Cloud Data Flow, Spring Cloud Stream, and Spring XD codebases.
Existing unit and integration tests are in place; only new features require new tests.
The development environment is set up with Java 17+, Maven/Gradle, and appropriate CI pipelines.
Each user story is estimated for a single developer working full-time; overhead for code review and non-development tasks is excluded.
The investigation stories (U3, U4) will produce documentation and prototypes, not production code.
UI work (U1) assumes an existing frontend build toolchain (e.g., Webpack) and component library.
No major architectural changes are required; features are additive.

activities.activity_name: Implement aggregated progress bar for composed jobs (U1)
activities.activity_description: Design and implement a backend service to aggregate progress of sub-jobs within a composed job, and add a frontend progress bar component to display it.

activities.activity_description: Add functionality to restart an existing composed job, including state handling and a new REST endpoint.
Research and prototype integration of Spring Cloud Data Flow with Kafka 0.9 API changes, produce a report with areas of improvement.
Investigate and document how to bootstrap Lattice-based infrastructure for bare metal deployment of Spring Cloud Data Flow, create scripts if feasible.

activities.activity_name: Implement dot-delimited property resolution for stream definitions (U5)
activities.activity_description: Extend Spring Cloud Stream to support dot-delimited syntax for resolving properties in Tuple and JSON types.
Add tab completion for modules and their options in the Spring Cloud Data Flow shell using Spring Shell's built-in completion support.
Create Marathon configuration files, Docker images, and documentation to deploy Spring Cloud Data Flow on Apache Mesos.
Extract the Redis JUnit @Rule test fixture into its own Maven module, set up CI, and publish to a separate repository.
Run end-to-end tests combining all new features, fix any integration issues, and ensure backward compatibility.
Update user guides, reference documentation, and API docs for all new features across the affected projects.
Modify Maven/Gradle build files, CI pipelines, and repository settings to accommodate new modules and dependencies.
